name: Zcash Korea
description: Zcash community and advocacy in Korea
about: Korean-language Zcash community led by ambassador Aiden Jeon, appointed in March 2025 through a ZecHub DAO proposal. Around 300 members chat on KakaoTalk and share technical resources and education, despite South Korea's restrictions on privacy coins.

name: Zcash Russia
description: Zcash community and advocacy in Russia
about: Russian-speaking Zcash community that promotes privacy-focused money and publishes Zcash information for Russian speakers through its project site and blog.

name: Zcash Arabia
description: Zcash community and advocacy in Arabic-speaking region
pin_note: Representative pin for Arabic-speaking region; centred on Saudi Arabia
about: Arabic-language Zcash community working to bring privacy education and Zcash awareness to Arabic-speaking users across the region.

name: Zcash Brazil
description: Zcash community and advocacy in Brazil
about: Portuguese-language community active since 2022, promoting Zcash through Discord, social media and events with a focus on education, translation and design. It organized Zcon Voices 2023, the first Zcash event in Latin America.

name: Zcash Ghana
description: Zcash community and advocacy in Ghana
about: Ghanaian community running Zcash education and adoption efforts through events and meetups, including an X Space in July 2025 and its first in-person meetup in Accra. Part of its work is funded by ZEC donations through Free2Z.

name: Zcash Español
description: Zcash community and advocacy in Spanish-speaking region
about: Main hub for Spanish-speaking Zcash users, with a website of articles and guides, a directory of local Zcash clubs, a YouTube channel and a newsletter. It also hosts events across Latin America and Spain.

name: Zcash Español
description: Zcash community and advocacy in Spanish-speaking region
pin_note: Representative pin for Spanish-speaking regions in Latin America
about: Main hub for Spanish-speaking Zcash users, with a website of articles and guides, a directory of local Zcash clubs, a YouTube channel and a newsletter. It also hosts events across Latin America and Spain.

name: Zcash Nigeria
description: Zcash community and advocacy in Nigeria
about: Community launched through the Global Ambassador Program and led by Chidi. It holds meetups and workshops in Nigeria, Ghana and Uganda, with a focus on onboarding local merchants to Zcash.

name: Zcash Ukraine
description: Zcash community and advocacy in Ukraine
about: Ukrainian-language community launched in June 2025 and coordinated by Beyond. It runs five social channels, improved Zcash's local search visibility, and now hosts small educational events and gamified learning.

name: Zcash Turkey
description: Zcash community and advocacy in Turkey
about: Turkish-language community, active since 2024 and led by Batuhan. It creates Turkish Zcash content, runs social channels and a YouTube channel, and organizes local events.

name: Zcash India
description: Zcash community and advocacy in India
about: Indian Zcash community running the ZcashIND Live series and in-person meetups across cities such as Bhopal, Indore, Surat, Vadodara and Mumbai, covering wallets, privacy and ZK proofs.

name: Zcash East Africa
description: Zcash East Africa is dedicated to promoting digital privacy, financial freedom, and blockchain innovation through education, community events, technical workshops, and ecosystem development. The initiative aims to create a regional hub where individuals can explore privacy enhancing technologies, learn about zero knowledge proofs, and participate in the growing global Zcash network.
about: East African community that launched its official Zcash channels on May 3, 2026 to build an inclusive regional hub. It hosts meetups, such as one at Egerton University, and shares Zcash ecosystem updates translated into Swahili.

name: Zcash South Africa
description: Privacy🛡️. Freedom. Zcash 🦓 Community for South African region
about: South African community focused on raising awareness of Zcash, teaching people how private money works, and encouraging adoption in the region.
